E1001.title: Session token missing
E1001.cause: The request carried no session token in the Authorization header.
E1001.handling: Send the token. Do not retry without one.

E1002.title: Session token expired
E1002.cause: The session token is past its expiry time.
E1002.handling: Refresh the session through the auth service, then retry once.

E1003.title: Session token signature invalid
E1003.cause: The token signature does not verify against the current signing key.
E1003.handling: Treat as a forged or corrupted token. Force a new login.

E1004.title: Session revoked
E1004.cause: The user signed out on another device or an administrator revoked the session.
E1004.handling: Force a new login. Do not refresh.

E1010.title: Password reset token reused
E1010.cause: A password reset link was opened a second time.
E1010.handling: Ask the user to request a new link.

E1011.title: Too many login attempts
E1011.cause: The account exceeded five failed logins in fifteen minutes.
E1011.handling: Wait for the lockout window to pass. Do not retry automatically.

E1020.title: Role not permitted
E1020.cause: The caller's role does not allow the requested operation.
E1020.handling: Surface the error. Never retry with an elevated role.

E2001.title: Required field missing
E2001.cause: A required field was absent from the request body.

E2002.title: Field type mismatch
E2002.cause: A field had the wrong type, for example a string where an integer was expected.
E2002.handling: Return a 400 naming the field and the expected type.

E2003.title: Field out of range
E2003.cause: A numeric field fell outside its allowed range.
E2003.handling: Return a 400 with the allowed range.

E2004.title: Unknown field
E2004.cause: The request body contained a field the schema does not define.
E2004.handling: Reject the request. Silent dropping hides client bugs.

E2010.title: Currency not supported
E2010.cause: The currency code is not in the list the payments provider accepts.
E2010.handling: Return a 400. Do not convert currencies implicitly.

E2011.title: Amount precision too high
E2011.cause: An amount carried more decimal places than its currency allows.
E2011.handling: Return a 400. Never round money silently.

E2020.title: Email address malformed
E2020.cause: The email address failed the syntax check.

E3001.title: User soft-deleted
E3001.cause: The user row has a non-null deleted_at.
E3001.handling: Return 404. Do not resurrect the row implicitly.

E3002.title: User not found
E3002.cause: No user row exists for the id.

E3003.title: Email already registered
E3003.cause: Another active user already has this email address.
E3003.handling: Return 409. Do not reveal which account holds it.

E3010.title: Profile update conflict
E3010.cause: Two updates to the same profile raced and the second lost.
E3010.handling: Re-read the profile and reapply the change once.

E4001.title: Payment method missing
E4001.cause: The order has no payment method attached.
E4001.handling: Ask the customer for a payment method before authorizing.

E4002.title: Payment method expired
E4002.cause: The card on file is past its expiry date.
E4002.handling: Ask the customer to update the card.

E4010.title: Provider credentials rejected
E4010.handling: Check the key for the environment. Do not retry.

E4011.title: Provider rate limit
E4011.cause: The provider returned a rate limit response.
E4011.handling: Retry with exponential backoff, up to four attempts.

E4020.title: Payment provider unreachable
E4020.handling: Retry with exponential backoff, up to four attempts.

E4021.title: Payment authorization expired
E4021.cause: The authorization hold lapsed before capture.
E4021.handling: Re-authorize, then capture. Do not retry capture alone.

E4022.title: Payment authorization declined
E4022.cause: The issuer declined the authorization request.
E4022.handling: Surface the decline to the customer. Do not retry automatically.

E4030.title: Refund exceeds capture
E4030.cause: A refund asked for more than the captured amount.
E4030.handling: Reject the refund and report the captured amount.

E4031.title: Refund window closed
E4031.cause: The capture is older than the provider's refund window.
E4031.handling: Route to manual credit. Do not retry.

E4040.title: Webhook signature invalid
E4040.cause: A provider webhook failed signature verification.
E4040.handling: Drop the event and alert. Never process an unverified webhook.

E4041.title: Webhook replayed
E4041.cause: A provider webhook arrived with an event id already processed.
E4041.handling: Acknowledge it and do nothing. Processing is idempotent by event id.

E5001.title: Order not found
E5001.cause: No order row exists for the id.

E5002.title: Order belongs to another user
E5002.cause: The order's user_id does not match the caller.
E5002.handling: Return 404, not 403, so order ids cannot be probed.

E5010.title: Order total mismatch
E5010.cause: The order total does not equal the sum of its line items.
E5010.handling: Recompute the total from line items and reject the write.

E5011.title: Order already captured
E5011.cause: Capture was called twice for one authorization.
E5011.handling: Treat as success. Capture is idempotent by order id.

E5012.title: Order cancelled
E5012.cause: An operation was attempted on a cancelled order.

E5021.title: Quote expired
E5021.cause: The quote is older than its validity period.

E5030.title: Inventory reservation failed
E5030.cause: Inventory could not reserve every line item.
E5030.handling: Release the partial reservation and return 409.

E6001.title: Webhook URL unreachable
E6001.cause: The notification webhook did not answer.
E6001.handling: The service retries RETRY_ATTEMPTS times with RETRY_BACKOFF_MS backoff. Do not add a caller retry.

E6002.title: Webhook returned 4xx
E6002.cause: The receiving endpoint rejected the notification.
E6002.handling: Do not retry. Log the response body for the owner of the endpoint.

E6003.title: Notification queue full
E6003.cause: The outbound queue reached its capacity.
E6003.handling: Back off and retry. Callers already received success when the message was queued.

E6010.title: Template missing
E6010.cause: No template exists for the notification type.
E6010.handling: Fail the send and alert. Never send an empty notification.

E6011.title: Template variable missing
E6011.cause: A template referenced a variable the payload lacks.
E6011.handling: Fail the send and name the variable.

E7001.title: Report query timed out
E7001.handling: Narrow the date range or use the precomputed daily table.

E7010.title: Read replica lagging
E7010.cause: The reporting replica is more than 60 seconds behind.
E7010.handling: Serve the report with a staleness banner, or wait.

E7020.title: Export too large
E7020.handling: Ask for a narrower filter or use the async export.

E9001.title: Dependency health check failed
E9001.cause: A downstream dependency failed its health check at startup.
E9001.handling: The service refuses to start. Fix the dependency first.

E9002.title: Configuration key missing
E9002.cause: A required configuration key was not set.
E9002.handling: The service refuses to start and names the key.

E9003.title: Configuration value invalid
E9003.cause: A configuration value failed its type or range check.
E9003.handling: The service refuses to start and names the key and the rule.

E9010.title: Feature flag service unreachable
E9010.handling: Fall back to the defaults compiled into the service.
